rationale: Residual load after hydro and storage is 75/90/85 MW (250 MWh total). Each thermal unit is dispatched within its [pmin,pmax] range every hour: gas sits at pmin=20 MW (more expensive, 38 USD/MWh) and the cheaper coal unit (22 USD/MWh) covers the remainder, giving coal 55/70/65 MW. Cost = 190*22 + 60*38 = 6460 USD. Emissions = 190*0.75 + 60*0.35 = 163.5 ton, below the 200-ton cap.
